{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Relaxed Workday Outfit:
Dark washed denim straight-leg trousers, relaxed taper cut, mid-thigh length, #2a2f3d (charcoal blue), heavy weight cotton twill with a soft stretch.
Waffle-knit crewneck long-sleeve tee, classic fit with dropped shoulders, hip-length hem, #664332 (burnt sienna), soft cotton jersey.
Chunky white leather sneakers, relaxed round toe, ankle height, pure white leather and rubber sole.
This ensemble embodies the requested "relaxed workday" vibe while maintaining a polished office-appropriate look through tailored denim rather than jeans. The burnt sienna tee provides a warm, creative pop of color that complements her deep skin tones without being overly loud. The neutral charcoal trousers and clean white shoes create a balanced silhouette suitable for sitting at a desk all day in autumn weather."}
